user_prompt: Show me my 5 most recently sent email campaigns.
judge_criteria: The answer identifies 5 email campaigns (or fewer if the account has fewer sent campaigns).
The listed campaigns are ordered newest-to-oldest by send date.
Each campaign includes at minimum a name or identifier so the user can recognize it.
The answer is scoped to email campaigns specifically — not SMS, push, or other channels.
No fabricated or hallucinated campaign names appear.
notes: Baseline single-turn task. Establishes the floor for both MCPs on a trivial list call — what does a one-shot question cost? Used as the reference point for measuring how per-turn costs compound at longer conversations.
